config.fit: sequential over sites, earlier sites edited
config.sites: rope: mlp0, attn/mlp 1-11, out; hybrid/ape: attn/mlp 0-11, out

rules.erasure: Erasure check at an edited site (its readout sees the edited stream): normalised SSDC N <= 0.1, and on held-out images exact probe <= 4.0x chance and row and column probes <= 1.5x chance (RB-6 / RB-8 thresholds). Where N is undefined (intact - floor < 0.10) the probes decide.
rules.normalisation: N = (SSDC - floor) / (intact - floor) at the same readout, only where intact - floor >= 0.1. Floor = all rotations off (RoPE), embedding zeroed (APE), both (hybrid).
rules.top1: Top-1 cost = intact - arm in points on the same 5,000 images, with a paired SE.
rules.reading: Classifiers (RB-8's rule, unchanged). C = top-1 cost of full_mean (every site), C0 = cost of full_offset (the same vectors at the wrong slots), F = cost of removing position entirely. BARELY USED if C < 10% of F; USED if C >= 10% of F and C - C0 > 3 paired SE; CANNOT TELL otherwise. The statement covers the per-slot mean component only.
rules.outcome: Outcome (labels only; the team decides the text): A if every RoPE classifier (naver ViT-B, naver ViT-S, reg1-gap) reads BARELY USED; B if any reads USED; C otherwise. The hybrid and the APE models are reported with the same rule.
